audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads Skill/Singed/Singed/Skill/Skill/Singed/Singed but the prose says Gnar controls the tempo at 2, still dictates at 4-5, and the late game is a macro coin-flip.
audit.why: Chart and why-lines disagree on four rows; the packet chart matches the prose.
audit.corrected: Skill / Gnar / Skill / Gnar / Singed / Singed / Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 and first-item rows in the full layer are generic template text; the Mega-form spike gives a fabricated '25-second window' for a wasted GNAR!.
audit.why: GNAR! is 90/60/30 seconds and is only castable in Mega form. A player told 25 seconds will re-engage into a live ultimate.
audit.corrected: 90s at rank 1, Mega-only; level 6 is Insanity Potion plus Ghost outrunning Hop; first item is Rylai's plus the grounding.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says mini-Gnar can 'hop any Mega Adhesive you throw' and never mentions grounding once.
audit.why: Mega Adhesive grounds, and grounding shuts off dashes. Hop/Crunch (22/19.5/17/14.5/12s, 475 range) is Gnar's only dash in either form. Thrown in his path he simply leaps it; dropped under his feet it stops the leap from casting at all. That distinction is the whole matchup and the page had it backwards. Boomerang Throw is 16s at rank 1 with 1100 range, well outside Poison Trail.
audit.corrected: Glue under his feet, not in his path; Hop 22s at rank 1; Boomerang 16s/1100 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged zero cooldown-sequencing cues on this page; the cooldown block carries no numbers at all.
audit.why: Every actionable window here is a number: Hop 22s, Boomerang 16s, GNAR! 90s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to the cooldown block, report and dos.

audit.why: Flinging Mega Gnar away from walls to deny the GNAR! wall-stun is already stated and is correct — Fling places the target behind Singed.

edits.before: Fling + glue starts punishing anyone who chases. Only take the trade when Gnar's GNAR! is down.
edits.after: Hyper stacks let mini-Gnar burst you in hop-in trades before your glue is up — give him nothing at 2.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Gnar must walk into your range.
edits.after: Mega Adhesive is up — glue under his feet grounds Hop and he cannot leap out, but Boomerang still zones you.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around GNAR!'s cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Boomerang zones you from 1100 range and mini-Gnar dictates the tempo — proxy behind his tower for CS instead of contesting the wave.

edits.before: Ult-ghost-proxy is a macro weapon — you win by farming where he is not. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gnar's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Insanity Potion plus Ghost outruns his 22-second Hop, so mini-Gnar cannot kite you any more — this is where the lane turns over to you.

edits.before: Rylai's Crystal Scepter is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on GNAR!'s cooldown.
edits.after: Rylai's makes every step in the cloud a commitment, and grounded in glue his Hop will not fire.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Gnar carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: He matches your split with his own mobility and one GNAR! can wall-stun your team — this comes down to macro.

edits.before: - Gnar GNAR!: matchup-defining — His Mega all-in. Fling out of it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Gnar Hop: 22s at rank 1 — Mega Adhesive grounds it, so glue under his feet and he is stuck. - Boomerang: 16s at rank 1, 1100 range. - GNAR!: 90s at rank 1 and castable only in Mega form.

edits.before: Track Gnar's GNAR! (Mega Stun): His Mega all-in. Fling out of it. When it is down — Poison-kite + fling him.
edits.after: Glue under his feet grounds Hop (22s at rank 1). Fling Mega Gnar away from walls so GNAR! has nothing to stun into.

edits.before: His Mega all-in. Fling out of it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It is 90s at rank 1 and Mega-only — Fling him away from any wall.

edits.before: Gnar wastes GNAR! (Mega Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Glue under his feet grounds Hop — mini-Gnar cannot leap the trail.

edits.before: Rylai's Crystal Scepter means every step through Poison Trail slows Gnar hard enough that he cannot hop away cleanly, and the Fling-glue-trail chain now sticks even in mini form.
edits.after: Rylai's makes every step through Poison Trail a commitment — and Mega Adhesive under his feet grounds Hop outright, so the Fling-glue-trail chain sticks even on mini-Gnar's escape.

edits.before: GNAR! (his ultimate stun) is his only clean way to stop your pattern — track his rage bar every trade and Fling him AWAY from walls when it is high to deny the stun.
edits.after: GNAR! is 90 seconds at rank 1 and castable only in Mega form — track his rage bar, and when it is full Fling him away from every wall so the throw has nothing to stun you into.

edits.before: Mini-Gnar can Boomerang you from outside Poison Trail and hop any Mega Adhesive you throw — you have no level-1 answer to ranged poke, so concede and set the wave.
edits.after: Mini-Gnar Boomerangs you from 1100 range, well outside Poison Trail, but with one ability each neither of you can kill — concede the poke and set the wave.

edits.before: Mega Adhesive is online and you can finally threaten a root-into-Fling, but his Boomerang range still zones you and he can disengage before you get a full poison cloud on him.
edits.after: Mega Adhesive is online: glue under his feet grounds Hop so he cannot leap out, and a Fling into it roots him — but Boomerang still zones you off the wave before your cloud lands.

notes: The page had the central interaction backwards: it told the player mini-Gnar can hop any Mega Adhesive, when the glue grounds and a grounded Gnar cannot cast Hop at all — the fix is to drop it under his feet rather than in his path. Also removed a fabricated '25-second window' for a spent GNAR!; it is 90/60/30 and Mega-only. Level chart flipped as one atomic group. Kit flag note: the kit tags GNAR! with 'terrain', but Riot's description only says enemies thrown into a wall are stunned — no terrain is created, so nothing was written from that flag. Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds is irrelevant here (no heal in Gnar's kit) and was deliberately left out. UNVERIFIED and left alone: whether Fling's knockup can be used to interrupt the Mega transformation, and exact Mega-form duration.
